name: Asama Makoto
source:
Makoto is a second-year student and [url=/c16395]Kyouko[/url]'s nephew and [url=/c16392]Arisa[/url]'s first cousin. He studies in a high school specialized in Arts: "2D" Arts (painting, drawing,...), "3D" Arts (sculpture, model making,...) and "Computer" Arts (computer graphics, audiovisual,...). He is very friendly with his senpai, [url=/c16396]Youta[/url]. Towards the end of his second year, Makoto met [url=/c16389]Tsukuyo[/url], [url=/c16390]Asuza[/url] and [url=/c16391]Madoka-senpai[/url] in the workshop that serves as their club room and eventually joined them. 

After a while, Makoto befriended the three young women and introduced them to Arisa so that they could become friends and then take them to his aunt's café, named Modulor, where he introduced them to his talents as a cook and pastry chef.

His aunt Kyouko plans to give him his coffee once he will graduates to take over the family business. However, Makoto does not want to make a career in the restoration and he is done to gives everything to succeed in the path in which he has committed.

His favorite artistic fields are drawing and wood carving.

[spoiler]During the game, Makoto passes his second year and moves to the next grade (third year).

Makoto worries a lot about Arisa because he is afraid that she will be alone again when him, Azusa and Tsukuyo will graduate.

Makoto is nice to everyone, even with [url=/c16394]Hijiri[/url] who has challenged Tsukuyo for the first place of the great art exhibition of the school. His kindness makes people come to appreciate him easily and Hijiri tries to become his friend (not openly because of her pride). The negative side of this personality trait is that his girlfriend thinks that Makoto is cheating on her with Hijiri (because they are often together). However, everyone has confidence in Makoto, and this suspicion of adultery doesn't stay long in the minds.[/spoiler]
